notes: Dashed strokes now space their dashes the way Figma does: the pattern is stretched slightly so it fits the line or shape evenly, with the first dash centred on the start. No more leftover sliver at the end of a dashed line, or seam on a dashed circle.
The dash lengths in AE are the fitted ones, and the dash Offset centres the first dash.
